Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

Emilio sits with Ruth — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.

A person, maybe 60s watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)

★ IDENTIFIED: Physic Nut. Small tree, often planted as a living fence. The seeds are POISON. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Physic Nut too.

A person, maybe 60s spends the afternoon with the tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. Raw, it knots the stomach. Cooked... fine. The fire learns the rule before the name: cook it, or else.
From the lumped bag: White Oak Acorns — named, and out.
